summary: preinstall script fetches and executes shell payload from hardcoded bare IP
details: package.json declares a preinstall lifecycle script that probes an internal SSRF endpoint (http://bsrc-ssrf.n.baidu-int.com/bsrc_uid) to obtain a host identifier, base64-encodes it, and sends it as a query parameter to http://49.232.169.67:43817/bsrc-r252 over plain HTTP. It then downloads a shell script from http://49.232.169.67:80/slt (with a wget fallback) and pipes the response directly to sh, followed by sleep 9d to stall the install. Installing this package triggers automatic execution of attacker-controlled shell code from a bare IP with no TLS and no integrity verification, and leaks a host/network fingerprint to the same endpoint before the payload runs.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
